ActorTalk: With the way I am now... can I really do it?
I didn't take part in that battle for certain reasons.
All of my comrades were there already.
By the time I'd finished my duties and was about to join them in heading up into the skies...
Meanwhile, I received orders to preserve our effective forces, so I became a commandant at the very rear.
Responsible for civilian evacuation and supply transport.
Later, they received a medal for this and became an instructor.
Fate truly is an elusive thing, 【kuroname】.
